capabilities: Track time spent with the vault open
Award XP for vault time and note count
Track experience points under a level system
Configure XP rates and reset XP and level
disambiguation: Not a TTRPG character or stat tool; it gamifies vault usage itself with XP and levels.
extras: Work in progress: the pet feature is announced but not yet implemented. Manual installation requires cloning the repository into .obsidian/plugins. XP reset does not delete or modify notes.
problem: Obsidian gives no sense of progression or reward for time spent writing and organizing notes.

relations.evidence: I want to eventually replicate something like vscode-pets but for Obsidian

summary: Gamification plugin that awards experience points for time spent with the vault open and for the number of notes, tracked as a level.
